featuredTours.description: Handcrafted Himalayan adventures — treks, tours, safaris and scenic escapes, all led by local experts.

exploreNepal.eyebrow: We make your travel dreams come true,
exploreNepal.title: Explore Nepal with Your Company Pvt. Ltd.
exploreNepal.bodyHtml:
Your Company Pvt. Ltd., known simply as Your Company, is an independent, Kathmandu-based trekking, tour and travel company with over 20 years of experience in Nepal's tourism and hospitality industry. We specialize in trekking, hiking, tours, holidays, jungle safaris and climbing adventures across the Nepal Himalayas, and extend our travel services to Bhutan and Tibet.

Our best-selling holiday packages include the Everest Base Camp, Annapurna Base Camp, Manaslu Circuit, Langtang Valley, Annapurna Circuit, Kathmandu Tour, Pokhara Tour, Spirit of Nepal, Chitwan Safari and the Nepal Bhutan Tour.

whyItems.title: 20+ Years Experienced Team
whyItems.body: Our guides and trip planners have spent over two decades on the trails and in the villages of Nepal, so every itinerary is built on first-hand knowledge.

whyItems.title: Registered and Authorized
whyItems.body: Your Company Pvt. Ltd. is a government-registered and authorized trekking and travel company, fully licensed to operate in Nepal.

whyItems.title: Happy Clients and Repeated Customers
whyItems.body: Travelers from around the world trust us, and many return year after year for their next trek, tour or climb.

whyItems.title: Use of Local Products
whyItems.body: We stay in local lodges, eat local food and hire local porters and guides, so your trip supports the communities you walk through.

faqs.q: What is Your Company Pvt. Ltd.?
faqs.a: Your Company Pvt. Ltd. is a Kathmandu-based trekking, tour and travel company offering treks, peak climbs, tours and safaris across Nepal, Bhutan and Tibet.

faqs.q: Where is Your Company Pvt. Ltd. located?
faqs.a: Our main office is in Kathmandu, Nepal. See the contact page for the full address and map.

faqs.q: What is the best time to travel to Nepal?
faqs.a: Spring (March to May) and autumn (September to November) offer the clearest views and the most stable weather for trekking.

faqs.q: How to get a Nepal tourist visa?
faqs.a: Most nationalities can get a visa on arrival at Kathmandu airport or apply online in advance. We can guide you through the steps.

points.title: Know the destinations
points.body: We provide local expert guides on our trekking and tour holidays who interpret the destination, people, culture, lifestyle, history, geography and much more. No one can interpret the destination better than the locals.

points.title: Peace of mind
points.body: We arrange all the related travel services for your holidays from arrival to departure, including airport transfer, hotel booking, transport, domestic flights, guides, tours, porters, permits and entrance fees. You enjoy your holiday with peace of mind.

points.title: Travel safety
points.body: Adventure trekking holidays involve traveling into the high Himalayas, and it is risky to travel alone without a guide. You are safe when you are on our guided holidays.

points.title: Support local economy
points.body: Nepal has been facing unemployment problems, and tourism is a fast-growing industry that can offer job opportunities to many locals, including porters, guides, drivers and organizers. Taking guided holidays means you support the local economy.

cta.title: Ready for the Himalaya Holidays?
cta.description: Let us know when and where you want to spend your next holiday in Nepal, Bhutan, and Tibet. Locals know more than anyone about the destinations. Let's plan your next travel with Your Company Pvt. Ltd.
